items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: Dick Brady and Gene Brady. That was two popular brothers too.

ctx.x: Dick Brady and Gene Brady. That was two popular brothers too. Dick Brady and Gene Brady. They were very popular, popular in the Spoten district. But they used so much hop, they smoked so much. They lived off of that. Dick was cremated in Los Angeles. He died and was cremated out there. Dick was.
